title: Q-SPEC-09-model-floor-guard: model floor guard over source and deployed bundles, and the standards gate (US-09-R11)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q US-09-R11 -- foundation tests/foundation
**Status:** closed

specs/US-SPEC-09-caps-kill-switches-model-ladder.md lists as PLANNED in both status sections: no code scans every Worker's source and its deployed bundle for a banned model class, and no code checks the output and context minimums of section 5. foundation/modelwatch.py only finds retired model ids.

Add a floor list and an exemption registry as data, a guard that strips comment-only lines and the list's own declarations, matches source files and the deployed bundle read back from the host, exits 1 and files one item per Worker on a hit, and a standards check of every configured model's limits. Wire it as a failure-audit detector and add tests named for US-09-R11. Then move the lines to BUILT.

**Prediction:** floor_guard_tests_named >= 1 within 336 h (the number of lines the done check finds; 0 today)
**Out of scope:** changing which models the system routes to, or removing a model from doctrine/models.json.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q US-09-R11 -- foundation tests/foundation (exit 0): a guard and its test name the requirement. `python3 -m foundation failure_audit --check` still passes.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
